source_text: Sicut onus grave gravatae sunt super me. Venite ad me omnes qui laboratis et onerati estis. Gloria Christo. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Like a heavy burden they have weighed upon me. Come to me all who labor and are burdened. Glory to Christ. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[My iniquities have gone over my head; like a heavy burden >> Bible:Psalm 38:4]]. Christ answers: [[Come to me, all who labor and are heavy laden >> Bible:Matthew 11:28]]. Glory to Christ. Amen.
